node: Advanced-package substrates and upstream substrate materials
summary: Expanded the node around FC-BGA / ABF substrates, build-up insulating film, and copper/surface-treatment chemistry. The strongest chokepoint signal in the supplied evidence is not the finished substrate makers alone, but upstream yield-enabling inputs: ABF build-up film and copper-bonding / surface chemistry. US-listed pure plays are scarce; most direct exposure appears in Japan, Taiwan, Korea, or Europe. For a US-listed universe, this pass therefore uses a two-lane structure: reference anchors that validate demand and packaging dependence, plus underfollowed US-listed materials / process-chemistry candidates whose direct exposure must be verified in filings, product catalogs, and customer disclosures. No buy/sell recommendation is implied.
